Frontend Playwright E2E: (1) /mentor renders sidebar with mentor-role-input / mentor-industry-input / mentor-years-input + 4 starter buttons + past sessions region; clicking mentor-starter-1 streams a 1107-char response, mentor-input clears, and the new session appears in the sidebar (data-testid=mentor-session-<id>); (2) /dashboard shows dashboard-mentor-link, dashboard-nextbest banner with nextbest-cta explore link, and dashboard-recs grid (5 rec cards visible); (3) /quiz/agentic-ai-foundations loads 15 randomized questions with 'Randomized' badge + quiz-timer, correct answers matched by option text (15/15), submit issues certificate + view-certificate button; (4) /certificate/{id} renders cert-qr img with src=/api/certificates/{id}/qr.svg + share-certificate + share-linkedin + download-qr + cert-holder-name/course-title/id; (5) /verify/{valid} shows verify-qr + verify-success card, /verify/{invalid} shows verify-error card ('Credential not found').

minor.issue: SSE stream headers are correct (text/event-stream + X-Accel-Buffering: no) but the event generator does NOT emit a 'flush' delta before the first LLM chunk — under slow LLM cold-starts the client may wait 3-5s with no visible feedback. Consider a heartbeat 'data: {\"start\": true}' immediately after the response starts.

`payload.answers.pop('__perm__', None)` mutates the incoming dict; the mutated dict is then persisted into the QuizAttempt.answers field. Not a bug but semantically the stored answers no longer contain the permutation map (which is fine) — however if a caller reuses their answers dict client-side after retrieval they would see it stripped. Consider `payload.answers.copy()` before pop.

Cache is user+course scoped (24h). If the top course changes (e.g. after a new completion), the returned rationale MAY be stale (from prior top course) unless entry is invalidated. Consider adding a version key or clearing on new certificate issuance.

Uses os.environ.get('PUBLIC_APP_URL','') at request time — if PUBLIC_APP_URL is unset the QR encodes a relative /verify/{id} which is not scannable outside the app. Fine now (set in .env) but should assert env presence at startup or in a health check.

issues: Session cards use opacity:0 → hover:opacity-100 on the Trash icon — on touch devices there is no way to delete a session. Consider showing the trash icon always at 40% opacity.
Download QR button downloads the raw SVG — good for print/scan, but a PNG fallback would improve LinkedIn/email attachment UX. Optional.
Error card is minimal — 'Credential not found. No credential found with that ID.' — a single line CTA to 'Learn more' or 'Report suspicious credential' would raise trust posture.

OPTIONAL: Invalidate rec_rationales cache when a new certificate is issued (or key by 'user + top_slug_signature').

critical_code_review_comments: mentor_router preamble strategy is smart — it recaps last-6 messages into the new user turn when the emergentintegrations session cache expires. Continuity worked in test_chat_continuity_with_session_id.

assessment_router._shuffle_options correctly returns shuffled options + remapped correct + `_option_permutation` (server-truth). The endpoint strips `_option_permutation` and re-emits as `permutation` in the client view. Clean separation.

recommendation_router._score_courses recomputes on EVERY /recommendations call (no caching) — with 24 courses + 200 enrollments/certs limit it's cheap now, but consider a 5-min cache per user_id to reduce Mongo round-trips as catalog grows.

recommendation_router: `_rationale_from_llm` uses session_id=`rec-rationale-{md5(learner_context+slug)}` — same learner+course = same LLM session across users (learner_context differs per user so OK, but if two users had identical context+course the session cache would collide). Consider adding user_id to the md5 seed.

assessment_router: submit_quiz mutates payload.answers by popping __perm__ then stores the (now stripped) answers into QuizAttempt.answers. Storing the perm-less indices is fine for records but the attempt row loses the raw client selections. Consider storing both `answers_raw` and `answers_canonical`.

mentor_router: `LlmChat(...).with_model(...)` is created per request even when session already exists — the LlmChat instance is stateless per call (server-side session cache lives elsewhere), so no leak, but hoist the constant SYSTEM prompt build.
MentorRequest.message has no max-length — accepting an unbounded prompt from the client. Consider Field(max_length=8000).

assessment_router: passing_score default is 65 in course model but the QR endpoint doesn't reject certificates for expired or revoked credentials — Certificate has valid_until Optional[str] but is never enforced in /certificates/verify/{id}. Consider validating expiry in verify.

recommendation_router: no fallback when Claude API is down — returns a hardcoded 'This is your best next step…' string. Good graceful degradation, though logs 'rationale llm failed' via logger.exception which is correct.
